title: Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,093 vulnerabilities, including an exploited Outlook zero-day, CVE-2026-124194, and a CVSS 10.0
content_md:
Microsoft November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes 1,093 vulnerabilities, including an exploited Outlook zero-day, CVE-2026-124194, and a CVSS 10.0

via Mastodon https://securityonline.info/november-2026-patch-tuesday/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-124194.evidence: Event describes an exploited Outlook zero-day, CVE-2026-124194, fixed in the November 2026 Patch Tuesday release.
